headline: OpenAI Expands AI Agent Capabilities for Healthcare Teams
summary: OpenAI has expanded its AI agent capabilities for healthcare teams, enhancing their ability to manage complex tasks and improve patient care through advanced AI-driven tools and plugins.
whyItMatters: This expansion underscores the growing importance of AI in healthcare, offering practical solutions that can significantly improve efficiency and patient outcomes.
